summary: The Space Mission Design Game is an interactive game that allows participants to design, manage, and simulate complete space missions. Players make engineering decisions regarding spacecraft design, scientific instruments, launch vehicles, budget, power, mass, communication, and orbital constraints. They must manage limited resources, balance competing requirements, and evaluate how their decisions affect mission performance. The main goal is to provide a practical and engaging learning experience that helps students understand the challenges of real-world space mission planning through interactive simulation and decision-making.
